name: Climate & ESG Risk
description: Financed emissions, physical and transition risk exposure, and sustainability metrics.

metrics.name: financed_emissions
metrics.description: Attributed tCO2e using the stated attribution method

metrics.name: emissions_intensity
metrics.description: Financed emissions per unit of exposure or revenue

metrics.name: exposure_to_high_risk_sectors
metrics.description: Exposure to sectors flagged as high transition risk

conventions.rule: State the attribution method (e.g., PCAF) and the data vintage.
Never add scope 3 to scope 1 and 2 without labeling it; scope 3 double-counts across entities.

insight_rules.reason: Attribute via emissions and denominator separately.

caveats.text: Much emissions data is estimated rather than reported; show the data-quality score beside results.

chart_conventions.rule: Show emissions and exposure side by side by sector; they rank differently.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
